eps.d: Harold T. Stone, newly appointed judge of a New York night court, shocks everyone with his unorthodox ways.
The court deals with a psychiatric patient who is posing as Santa; a nasty shoplifter casts a cloud over the holidays.

After starting a pool on how old Judge Stone is, his records are searched by the staff who then discovers that the judge has a criminal record. Mean while a reporter is trying to get dirt on the court employees.
Harry meets a lonely woman who seems to know the details of his life and claims to be his long-lost mother; meanwhile a sleazy beauty contest promoter and his victims appear in court.
Bull sulks after a charitable organization turns down his help, claiming his size and appearance are intimidating.
The courtroom staff is on edge after a note threatening Harry comes through the window, and a bomb is discovered in the courtroom.

A prostitute mistakes Harry's kindness towards everybody he meets as a sign that he loves her. As a result, she starts following him around the courthouse. When she surprises him in his chambers wearing almost nothing more than a smile, Harry calls upon is friends for help in clearing the air with her.

Dan is infuriated when he discovers his attractive assistant is dating other men -- including Harry and Bull. During court, Harry has to make a hard decision about a set of fake tickets taken off a defendant.
Lana's prescribed medication for a virus results in changed behavior -- and it is Harry who must deal with her overactive libido.
A Soviet charged with selling stolen property would rather die in the courtroom than go to jail.
Harry falls for a rock star, but soon learns that the relationship won't work.
Bull takes care of a neighbor's baby, not realizing that the mother has abandoned the child.
Harry has to deal with a case in which a woman has to choose between her two husbands: one who she thought died while serving in Vietnam, and the man she married after former was declared dead.
An attractive witness falls for Harry -- the only problem is that she's a nun.

eps.t: Christine and Mac (a.k.a. Daddy for the Defense)
eps.d: A young defense attorney's (Markie Post) court debut is marred by the presence of her disruptive father.
Billie Young ends up in contempt of court when she refuses to tell Judge Stone the location of a cat that is involved with the current court case.
The courtroom turns into chaos when a man who wins a lottery gives the ticket to Harry and asks him to choose someone worthy to give the money to.

As Dan contemplates purchasing a small California farm to use as a tax shelter, Harry and the others at court have to deal with a young computer whiz who is holding his school district's permanent records hostage while holed up in the judge's chambers.

After Bull signs up to be a foster father to underprivileged kids, the young boy he gets assigned Billie discovers a surprising secret about him – that Andy is really a girl in disguise. Trying to impress a co-worker, Dan tells her that he can get tickets for an upcoming Jets game, and later pleads with Mac in an attempt to get his tickets so he can take her on a date.
Harry's antics in the courtroom finally get him called up before the judicial review board.
Harry has to make a tough decision involving a madams diary; Bull gets upset about a turkey destined to be Mac's family's thanksgiving dinner.
Harry is struck down in the middle of session by crippling stomach pains, but stubbornly refuses medical treatment.
A blizzard traps people in the courtroom and Dan in the elevator with a man who is attracted to him.
Mac marries a Vietnamese woman who has been threatened with deportation.
Billie helps Harry celebrate his birthday and an unexpected guest arrives in the form of a gun-toting burglar.
Dan's hick parents visit him at the courthouse after he has led everyone to believe that his parents had passed away years ago.

The courtroom is overrun by a group of escaped mental patients from a local hospital. They then try to convince Harry that they have been mistreated at the hospital. Meanwhile, Harry tries to raise Sea Monkeys in his office.
An old flame of Selma's shows up after 45 years; Harry has work to do in his office so he is replaced by a substitute judge for the night that seems to be a better judge than him.
A gypsy puts a curse on the courtroom when Harry upsets her and Bull passes out.
Bull quits his job in frustration and becomes a professional wrestler.
On Valentines day, Billie's new heartthrob has a criminal effect on her.
The courthouse staff believes that Dan is golddigging when he proposes to a homely woman who is heir to 40 million dollars.

eps.t: Mac and Quon Le: Together Again
eps.d: Mac starts to face the responsibility of his marriage when Quon Le appears in the courtroom; Harry has to choose between Dan and Billie when it comes to giving a mayors commission recommendation.
A Russian emigre and his visiting brother, who's hoping to defect, appear in court after causing a disturbance at a circus.
Harry turns down a physically challenged woman's invitation to a graduation ball.
Harry holds interviews trying to find Selma's replacement, meanwhile Bull goes on a bender while mourning Selma's death.
A defendant claiming to be from Saturn holds Dan hostage while demanding transmitter parts so he can contact his home planet.

Christine's dad shocks her by going out on a date for the first time in 8 years, then he ends up in jail. Meanwhile, Harry and the court staff get stuck with residents of a clothing optional apartment building who show up in the courtroom and take over.

eps.t: Mac and Quon Le: No Reservations
eps.d: Mac's grandfather disinherits him after finding that he has married Quon Le, an Asian woman.

Harry meets and falls for a woman while preparing for his annual Halloween party. She then ends up before him in court for dancing around a bonfire in central park with a female friend. Meanwhile a tabloid reporter pops up all over the courthouse trying to get dirt on people.
Dan's former college buddy (guest star Jim Bailey) has had a sex-change operation.
Dan is fired when he fails to get along with his diminutive new boss.
Harry offers a taste of freedom to a pampered rock star who hasn't been alone in public for more than 6 years.
Harry feels helpless when he's forced to rule against victims of circumstance. Meanwhile, Bull gets a new tv and his problems are just beginning.
Harry returns to his job after coping with his inability to help a destitute defendant and her son.
Florence discovers that Bull's latest girlfriend is a prostitute.

Desperate for money, Dan moonlights as a male escort. His second job becomes problematic when the woman he's escorting demands that he sleep with her. Meanwhile, Yakov returns to the courtroom to announce his wife is arriving in America.
A substitute judge arrests the staff when Harry takes a night off.
Harry becomes a foster father to the courthouse shoeshine boy.
Mac's in-laws arrive from Vietnam and move in with him and Quon Le, while Harry plans a surprise birthday party in Dan's honor.
Harry loses custody of Leon and bungles a chance to meet Mel Torme.
Florence is taken hostage by a grenade-carrying man who mugged Christine. Dan gets a hot stock tip then tries to come up with money to invest.

Harry tries to help a down and out magician that comes into the court room to be tried and turns out to have been his idol and inspiration. Meanwhile, Bull has issues with his paycheck when he discovers that Florence is making quite a bit more than he is.

Bull puts his job on the line to help a baby orangutan when an animal research doctor comes into the courtroom with theft charges. Dan has a run-in with a female amnesia victim with completely unexpected consequences.

The staff of the courtroom becomes upset when they discover that on Florence's birthday, she has reached the Judicial systems mandatory retirement age. They then try to figure out how to get her to be allowed to continue working at her job.

Harry runs into weather related problems as Hurricane Mel heads for Manhattan. The decision is made to continue with court room activities to pass the time which involves a bevy of pregnant women who become trapped in the courthouse during the storm.
Things get hectic in the courtroom as the pregnant women who are sheltering during the hurricane, have a chain reaction of starting their labor and the staff has to deliver a series of babies.

Harry receives a old letter in the mail from a missing family member and has to decide how to act on it. Meanwhile the courtroom staff has various encounters with a group of strange entertainers. With all the courtroom goings on, between new Baliff Roz, Harry meets Buddy Ryan for the first time.
After Dan saves Christine's life, he tells her that he wants to sleep with her. She then feels obligated to follow up and Harry and the others try to help her out by interfering with Dan's plans.

Bull gets upset when he writes a children's book for a contest entry and the publishers deem it too scary/offensive for young kids. Dan gets confused when his interactions with a plaintiff gives him mixed messages.

eps.t: Halloween II: The Return of Leon
eps.d: Leon, a runaway, returns just as Harry's putting the finishing touches on his annual Halloween party. Dan tries to talk the Prosecutor into inviting him to his high society Halloween party.
Dan is in the hospital to have surgery on a perforated ulcer, he insists on proving he can do his duties and shows up in the courtroom. He then ends up back in the hospital waiting for surgery.
Dan is in a coma, and his friends reminisce about all the good times they have had with him while maintaining a vigil at the hospital room.
While Harry is away, the replacement judge offers Dan a bribe.
A substitute judge jails Christine for contempt of court, then has a fling with Harry.
Dan, Roz and two Sumo Wrestlers become trapped in a elevator after a earthquake hits. Harry has a experience with a little boy in the courtroom that reminds him of someone.

A lady comes into the court charged with indecent exposure, she then turns out to be a princess and becomes accidentally engaged to Harry. Meanwhile, her brother shows up and Dan tries to sell Christine to him.
New Year's Eve in the courtroom finds the judge dealing with a diapered ``Mr. 1987'' and an escaped convict who's trying to get to Times Square.
A woman disrupts the court proceedings to confess to murdering her husband, while Dan decides to become a donor for a sperm bank.
Mac goes on a drunken binge due to Quon Le's spending habits and her unexpected news.
Christine shocks her coworkers when she announces that she is getting married.
Harry and the courtroom staff have until midnight to decide 200 cases while Dan has a hot date with a lady who is leaving town.
Harry is helped by a stray dog that saves him when his apartment catches on fire, then Dan is bitten by the dog and may have to go through the rabies shot series.
Christine's friend Heather comes into town and Harry and Dan war against each other for Heather's attentions. Harry has a surprise visit at a social event.
Christine has issues with a supervisor who she accuses of sexually harassing her. Meanwhile, Dan is trying to have a hot time with a woman who has retired from the wild life.
Dan is served for fathering a child, meanwhile Bull runs for Baliff shop steward and brings another Baliff's wrath down on him.
The naturalization ceremony for Quon Lee is interrupted when both she and Mac are hospitalized for abdominal pains, causing Harry to have to halt the performance of the ceremony.
Dan eagerly anticipates becoming a judge when everyone awaits the new judges list posting. He goes into shock when Christine Sullivan makes the list instead. Harry gets some disappointing news.

Harry discovers who was behind his loss of position with the courts and makes a career decision. Christine is sworn in as a judge and then has a private chat with the Mayor when she sneaks into his office after the ceremony.

With Christine having obtained Harry's job as judge back, it is now contingent on Harry having to be sworn back in before the deadline arrives. Now the entire courtroom staff are searching everywhere for a Harold Stone who can't be found.
The staff still is unable to find Harry to be sworn in by a judge that knows Harry. Harry is about to perform the prank of the century when he encounters a person that is about to commit suicide.

Bull has a near-death experience and insists God spoke to him. While Bull starts to give away all of his Earthly possessions, Mac deals with the new computer system that is driving him to the brink of insanity.
After Roz and her boyfriend break up Christine decides to help Roz recover, so they go out together to one of Roz's favorite hang-outs: a male strip club.
On Halloween, Dan believes he has sold his soul to the devil, and Harry gets locked inside a safe.
The man who saved Mac's life in Vietnam appears in court and asks Mac to do an illegal favor for him. Bull loses the body of a elderly man who died in the courthouse.
A veteran actor contemplates suicide when a lawsuit prevents him from portraying the Western hero that made him famous.
Dan's world has come crashing down: he's suffering from impotence. Meanwhile, Harry is given a personal assistant, a blind woman with a terrible attitude.
Part one. Harry tangles with a desperate man holding an original draft of the Constitution hostage in the courtroom. Meanwhile, Roz struggles with being diagnosed with diabetes.
Conclusion. The Constitution draft hostage escalates in Harry's courtroom while Dan and Christine try to save Roz after her insulin overdose leads to erratic behavior.
A blizzard traps everyone in the courthouse and cancels holiday plans, including a visit from Bull's mother, the skipper of a garbage scow.
Dan ends up being chained to a briefcase that contains a bomb; Joy demands that Bull pay more attention to her physical needs.
Christine's father comes to town, then stays with her while getting his RV worked on, becomes best buddies with Dan and basically drives her up a wall.
Dan ties up Mel Tormé so Harry can meet him, but the judge is preoccupied with trying to keep his stepfather Buddy and his catatonic schizophrenic friend out of the mental hospital.
Christine invites a stranger to her party, not realizing he's wanted by the mob.
Panic grips the courtroom as the gang races to clear 207 cases in one session so a millionaire will donate money to save an orphanage and so Dan can win an office pool for the most convictions

An old flame of Harry's drops by to renew their relationship but neglects to tell him she's married. Meanwhile, Dan bails out of bowling night with the staff so he can have sex with his latest fling, but he and Harry end up out on the ledge when Mac, Christine, Bull, and Roz go looking for them.
Soviet defector Yakov Korolenko returns for some help in getting a visa to return to Russia to visit his sick mother, while sparks fly between Harry and a charming Soviet consul named Ludmila.

The gang joins Roz in a therapist group she's required to attend to temper her hostile attitude at work, which turns into a police situation when a young, inexperienced gangbanger holds everyone hostage.

Harry becomes uncharacteristically glum and morose when an elderly judge dies after one of Harry's pranks. His friends urge him to respond when a new judge lays claim to Harry's crown as the "King of the Courtroom Cutups."
Mac quits after inheriting $2 million from his grandfather, leaving his friends at the mercy of the most incompetent court clerk in New York.
Part one of three. Dan flip-flops on his active duty for the Army Reserve until he learns it will be in a tropical paradise with a beautiful lady officer.
Part two of three. The court staff holds a memorial service for Dan.
Part three of three. Dan is forced to perform an appendectomy on one of his rescuers because of an injury to the doctor's hands. The court staff, meanwhile, prepares to hold Dan's memorial service.
A courthouse fire thwarts last-minute campaigning by would-be assemblyman Dan.
Harry is shocked to learn that his date is a former porn star.
A bungling bailiff trainee lets a psychotic mental patient escape.
An ill-timed clench with another woman throws Mac's Thanksgiving into chaos.
Dan's admission into a prestigious law club hinges on Christine's reaction to his sponsor's advances.

eps.t: Night Court of the Living Dead
eps.d: Christine, declared dead by a computer, is relegated to assisting her replacement.

Bull and Roz become involved in providing toys for orphan children and in the process, Roz ends up jailed because of a contempt of court charge. Meanwhile, Buddy shows up and decorates Harry's office, all the while talking about his good buddy Nick who sent presents over for Harry and all of his friends.
Bull scores very high on an I.Q. test and is offered a cushy job at a think-tank trying to communicate mentally with test animals.
Motherhood loses its appeal when Christine baby-sits a friend's energetic infant.
The Courtroom staff faces a audit.
A armed clown shows up in the middle of the courtroom audit.

eps.t: The Trouble Is Not in Your Set
eps.d: The staff mugs before courtroom TV cameras.
Bull is on a game show; a cantankerous judge jails Dan for contempt.
The staff meets Christine's elderly suitor; an amorous dowager offers Dan a campaign contribution.
When Harry finally meets Mel Torme, he gives his idol the flu.
Part one of two. Christine is suspicious when Harry secretly takes part in a government sting operation.
Part two of two. Harry's sting operation is successful; potential killers run loose in the courthouse. Buddy makes a startling revelation to Harry.
Roz falls for Christine's convict pen pal, unaware that he escaped while on furlough.
Christine reluctantly agrees to be Art's date for the Buffalo Lodge Ball.

eps.t: Yet Another Day in the Life
eps.d: Harry and the staff must try the overflow of cases by midnight.
Harry's life is thrown into turmoil when his eccentric father moves in with him.

eps.t: If I Were a Rich Man
eps.d: Bull saves a rich man's life, and Dan wants a piece of the action.
Christine falls for an undercover officer when they are locked in the court records vault together.

eps.t: Come Back to the Five and Dime, Stephen King, Stephen King
eps.d: On Halloween night, Harry loses his new bat, Tito, and an exorcist's curse resurrects the unquiet spirit of a defendant from fifty years earlier.
Harry embarrasses Christine in front of a very pro-feminist judge with his trick handcuffs while Dan repays a debt to Bull by taking him out on the town for a swinging evening.

Buddy meets a rich lady who does not know that he was in a mental hospital in the past and proposes marriage. Meanwhile, Dan has a homeless issue and tries to hid that he is partially living in his office at the court house.

Roz has major problems when her aunt visits from out of town and insists that she needs to get a guy and marry; Dan has a run in with a older lady who whispers something naughty to him that he almost can't believe.
Harry and Mac decide to market one of Quon Le's snack inventions. Christine has a unexpected visitor.

Part one of two. Dan gets a job offer from a prestigious lawyer who has a case he wants help with. Dan follows through then realizes he was made into a patsy and tries to do the right thing. Christine and Roz start a diet together.

Part two of two. Dan faces the possibility of disbarment when he tries to set things straight about the attempt to bribe him to get the lawyer's friends son off from his criminal act. Meanwhile, Roz and Christine still have problems with their dieting.
Harry and Dan try to impress a lady who anonymously writes romance novels who has several big secrets.

Christine's relationship with her detective boyfriend hits a rough spot in the road when his job interferes with a planned special date. Bull tries to come up with a act to top the completion at a Bailiff event.
After it is announced that a historic theater is going to be demolished, Mac has a close encounter with some old friends and Bull chains himself to the doors of the theater.

VHK-937 is a man from the future with a mission to save Dan from two thugs holding him hostage in the courtroom; Bull's current mission in life is to find a cure for the hiccups that are tormenting him.
Part one of two. Christine makes an impulsive decision at her farewell dinner with beau Tony, one that has severe repercussions when he leaves on an assignment he may not return from.
Part two of two. Christine deals with Tony's departure and her unexpected pregnancy.
Dan's girlfriend convinces him to appear as a shock-host of a talk show. Mac and Quon Le's planned vacation to Graceland encounters problems.
Harry's lousy day gets worse when he is forced to jail Mel Torme for contempt.
Old friend of the court Yakov asks for his father's visa to be extended.
Roz faces a lawsuit and no job after Bull borrows her gun and shoots himself in the foot, thanks to his sue-happy lawyer cousin.
While attending childbirth class, Christine imagines what life would be like if Harry, Dan, or Bull stepped up to be the father of her child.

eps.t: Still Another Day in the Life
eps.d: In another compilation of court cases, Harry helps a young man appearing before his court stop his girlfriend's marriage to a prefab preppie, and Wile E. Coyote gets put on trial for his years of harassing the Road Runner.
An episode of a news magazine show takes an inside look on Harry and the staff members of the Manhattan night court.
Christine goes into labor while trapped in an elevator with Harry's unstable father Buddy and a squeamish courtroom visitor.

Part one of two. Christine returns to the courtroom as a new mother and has problems due to the person who did her job while she was on leave; Dan starts receiving strange calls from a woman named Donna who he claims to not know; Harry receives a letter telling him he never finished school which would nullify his being able to be a practicing judge.
Dan learns that Bull slept with his visiting sister, and Bull decides to marry Dan's sister in order to regain his trust.
Harry may lose the woman of his dreams when he starts taking Dan's advice on how to date her. Mac has a run of bad luck and Quan Lee gives him her villages remedies for it.
Dan confidently struts his stuff at a charity bachelor auction with unexpected results, while Christine is a bundle of nerves over leaving her child and Tony.
The Night Court group expect Harry's annual Halloween Tricks and off the wall pranks. Dan becomes scheduled to be the next victim of a defendant known as "The Spirit Of Death".
Part one of two. When the staff is quarantined for the night, they spend the hours reminiscing about turning points in their lives that led them to being hired at the night court.
Part two of two. The turning-point stories continue.
The Night Court crew is assigned to Day Court for a week and Roz starts acting strangely, Christine has marriage issues and tries to change herself.

eps.t: A Night Court at the Opera
eps.d: Dan tries to win Margaret from Harry on a night at the opera; Mac makes a startling discovery while eating lunch; Religious zealots determine that Bull is their god.

Christine loses her babysitter when the woman turns up in the courtroom and has problems finding a new nanny. Harry has a bad flashback to when he was in school when the bully who picked on him turns up in his courtroom.

A street artist helps raise Christine's spirits, but his crush on her may land him jail time for repeat offenses. Meanwhile, Mac indulges a passion for photography, and so does Dan when he uses Mac's camera to take pictures of his latest sexual conquest.
A comics off-color humor stirs up a First Amendment debate among the staffers and a man of the cloth, as well as other courtroom observers. Bull publishes a book.
Roz goes after the mother of a TV brat that is shooting a TV pilot in the building.
Dan looks at Phil the bum in a whole new light when the bum rescues a defendant who's been left penniless by the late 1980s savings and loan crisis.

Dan anticipates a windfall from Phil the bum's will but gets a surprise instead. Meanwhile, Bull anxiously awaits a visit from his mother, an old salt due to retire from the sea and come live with her sonny boy.

Christine finds herself tense over finalizing her divorce, Harry is nervous about moving in with Margaret, Dan is frustrated over what to do with the Phil Foundation money, and Bull follows his mother's advice and looks for a wife - with the help of a matchmaker.

Harry gets a wealth of conflicting advice when he confides in his friends that he thinks Margaret is about to propose marriage, but Margaret has a bombshell that's bigger than Harry's proposal. Meanwhile, Christine has a divorce party.

eps.t: Hey Harry, F'Crying Out Loud-- It is a Wonderful Life ... Sorta
eps.d: Harry loses all interest in life after Margaret leaves him. An angel (in the shape of Mel Tormé) shows him what life would be like in the court without him.

The court staff worries that Dan's insomnia over spending all his time preparing for the Phil Foundation banquet may be affecting his sanity. Meanwhile, Bull wins a high-end toupee in a cereal contest, and his new hair attracts all the women who once thought he was weird and repulsive.

eps.t: With a Little Help from My Friends
eps.d: Roz tries Christine's "happy therapy" and sets the group back several months. Meanwhile, Jack's son finally admits to himself and his dad that running the newsstand isn't for him, and Dan's dealing with the Phil Foundation opens his eyes to all of society's ills.

When a State Supreme Court Justice woos Mac to clerk in his court, chaos soon follows in Harry's court. However, not long after having a conversation with the Justice, Harry begins to worry that Mac's new job has to do with the color of skin instead of with his job ability. Dan hires a valet who soon begins to drive him crazy.

When Harry gets placed on a list of New York's most interesting people, the fame and attention goes to his head. As a result, when he gets set up on a date with a pretty model on the same night as he made plans with Christine, he lies to get out of it, and as a result, Christine gets mad when she finds out about it.

eps.t: Where There's a Will, There's a Tony (1)
eps.d: Part one of two. Harry experiences some very mixed emotions when Tony tries to win Christine back, and the transformed Dan gets some help in running the Phil Foundation, from Phil's twin brother Will.

eps.t: Where There's a Will, There's a Tony (2)
eps.d: Part two of two. Dan has a plan to save the Phil Foundation and Harry doesn't like Christine getting close to her ex.

Part one of two. Harry wrestles with his feelings for Christine. Meanwhile, with Dan missing, the court hires a loud-mouthed, amoral DA named Oscar and Christine, who is also wrestling with her feelings for Harry, gets kidnapped at a costume party.

Part two of two. Christine finds herself in the court's sub-basement with Dan, who now goes by The Phantom of the Courthouse. Meanwhile, a detective is out to bust Dan for embezzlement, Bull keeps searching for Dan, and Oscar asks Lisette (the ditzy stenographer) out on a date.

eps.t: My Life as a Dog Lawyer
eps.d: Harry has to deal with an obnoxious foreign diplomat and prevent WWIII, while Dan struggles at his embarrassing new job.
Roz stuns her co-workers when her uptown husband pays a visit to secure a divorce so he can marry again.
Wanda learns on the 6-month anniversary of their first date that Bull must perform a miracle before he can marry her.

Dan tries to break up with the daughter of a crime boss, who insists Dan reconsider over dinner — and that he bring along Christine. Note: This is the only episode where Harry Anderson does not appear.
Bull's bachelor party turns into a disaster when the guys are stranded at a motel with no money and no transportation, and where Bull is kidnapped.
Christine's image of her law professor is shattered and Bull tries to regain his virginity.

After Christine gets her children's' book accepted to be published, Dan has her artist create some sexy drawings of Christine just for him. In the process, the drawings that Dan had drawn up accidentally are switched with the ones for the children's book. Meanwhile, Harry ends up teaching a class on law after he has to commit the class's teacher to a institution with unexpected results.

eps.t: Get Me to the Roof on Time
eps.d: Bull flees to the courthouse roof when others take over his wedding plans; Dan has a date with triplets.
On Christmas Eve, a bitter department store Santa holds Dan hostage.
Harry goes all out to get Mel Tormé to accept a man-of-the-year award unaware that it's a prank. Meanwhile, Dan and Will turn into bounty hunters.
A defendant comes into the court room claiming to own several New York City landmarks, the Brooklyn Bridge, the Statue of Liberty. Mac has problems with the lunches Quan Le makes for him
Mac agrees to pose for an underwear advertisement; Dan gets caught red-handed.
Roz hosts a makeup/poker party while Harry redecorates his office and Dan dallies with a courtroom cutie.
A doctor who runs a sexual surrogacy clinic is tried and Dan sees his opportunity for the ultimate job. A stranger is prowling the halls of the court asking questions about Christine.
Christine comes to find the way her promoter is handling the election disgusting. Dan reaches the point where he hates his side job. Mac's film of Bull becomes a cult hit.

eps.t: To Sir with... Ah, What the Heck... Love
eps.d: Dan begins kissing up to Harry as part of his campaign to replace him on the bench when he becomes a full-time law professor, and Art, the handyman, becomes a surrogate dad to Bull when he starts dating Bull's mama.

Roz has to make a decision about meeting a pen pal she has been corresponding with for several years; Harry and Dan discover a hidden safe in the Judges office and try to get it open to see what valuables are inside.
Part one of two. Harry considers his future -- Columbia Law School or touring with his idol; Christine faces Election Day.
Part two of two. Christine is elected to Congress; Bull is kidnapped by aliens; Harry rejects a faculty job.
Roz steals the show and Dan's spot with the in-crowd when a gossip columnist discovers her and Lisette tries to deal with her erotic dreams about Harry.
